about_the_game:
When you woke up from a coma, you found yourself in a space that seemed to be in an infinite loop, and you realized that this place was extremely eerie and terrifying.

You have discovered that the only way to escape from here is to determine whether there is an anomaly in each cycle of the space here.

All kinds of strange things kept happening during this period. In the darkness, it seemed as if something was peeping at you, preventing you from leaving here

Game Introduction

"Eerie Dossier:the Haunted Apartment"is a walking simulation game that combines horror and horror elements.

When you discover something unusual during the game, please return to the original route.

If no abnormal situation is found, please continue to pass through the room door.

Some abnormal situations may be accompanied by special sound effects, which can be easily recognized by wearing headphones.

There are a total of 52 different abnormal situations in the game, some of which are relatively hidden and require careful observation to confirm.

As the game progresses, you will discover secrets hidden beneath various abnormal phenomena during the investigation process.

Game controls

WASD：Move

Shift：Run

E：Interaction/Survey

F：Turn on/Turn off the flashlight（After you obtain it）

Esc：Menu
